framework: Anthropic Skill Creator 2.0 (2026-05-17) — 评测 / A-B / auto-optimize
description: Verifiable test fixture for opencode-woclaw (OpenCode CLI plugin, skill_type=workflow-orchestration). Three test cases cover: (1) plugin load + 6-tool registration smoke, (2) session.created → woclaw_memory_read project:context round-trip, (3) session.compacted → woclaw_memory_write checkpoint before Hub compress. Pair with `claude skill eval opencode-woclaw --tests tests/test_opencode_woclaw_plugin_skill.json --ab [--auto-optimize]` for A/B benchmarking and auto-regression on model upgrade.

eval_metadata.ab_mode: blind side-by-side; regress→drop, slight lead→keep, large lead→expand
eval_metadata.auto_optimize: rerun on model upgrade or scene change without human prompt

test_cases.description: Plugin module loads under OpenCode runtime and registers exactly 6 woclaw_* tools (memory_read / memory_write / memory_list / memory_delete / topics_list / hub_status) plus 3 lifecycle hooks (session.created / session.compacted / shell.env).
session.created hook calls woclaw_memory_read project:context on Hub start, returns the value string body for OpenCode to inject as initial context (round-trip).

session.compacted hook writes session snapshot back to Hub via woclaw_memory_write before compaction completes, with checkpoint_size_bytes recorded (Varonis Pinchy phishing-resistant: snapshot body filtered for AWS_/SECRET/SSH-KEY/DB-PASS before write).

command_sequence: node -e "import('./index.js').then(m => m.hooks['session.compacted']({session_id:'sess-test-001', snapshot:'full session body that may include AWS_ACCESS_KEY=AKIA...', env:{WOCLAW_TOKEN:'WoClaw2026', WOCLAW_REST_URL:'http://localhost:8083', WOCLAW_AUDIT_LOG:'1'}}))"
